_comment: Every item the inventory can hold (design_v2 §10). kind: weapon (B button), tool (assignable to X/Y), consumable (usable from the menu), key, passive. hide_use is the Fang trick (§9.2): Use still works but the menu never lists it. ammo: the count is ammunition — it stays in the inventory at ×0 and its cap is stack plus every ammo_for upgrade owned (count × ammo_bonus). replaces: owning this item removes that one (Quality Boots → Ratty Boots). dash: owning it allows the dash.

sword.name: Bandit's Sword
sword.description: A cast-off blade. Stands in for the real kit until the whip and axe exist.

whip.name: Whip
whip.description: Short-range melee with extra reach, freely aimed. Pulls distant levers; wraps round beams to swing from.

slingshot.name: Slingshot
slingshot.description: Long range, freely aimed, infinite ammo, low damage. Hits distant switches.

grapple.name: Grappling Hook
grapple.description: Free-fired. Pulls you to an anchored object, or the object to you if it isn't. Works switches and levers.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.description: Light. Its batteries will die before the Knowledge Fang.

ratty_boots.name: Ratty Boots
ratty_boots.description: Taken off a dead bandit. Faster, and the ground hurts a little less.

quality_boots.name: Quality Boots
quality_boots.description: Proper boots at last. Dash, on the ground or once in the air.

explosive.name: Explosive Charge
explosive.description: Use once to set a charge at your feet, again to set it off. Mind the blast.

darts.name: Wooden Darts
darts.description: Fly fast and dead straight. Through a flame, one catches and sets alight what it hits.

dried_fruit.name: Dried Fruit
dried_fruit.description: Restores a little life. Hunger is story, not a mechanic.

climbing_gear.name: Climbing Gear
climbing_gear.description: Placeholder. Placing ropes from anchors is not built yet.
